{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer, tailored fit, knee-length cut, deep midnight blue (#191970), fine wool blend.
Silk blouse, relaxed collar, elbow-length sleeves, ivory color (#FFFFF0), lightweight crepe.
Wide-leg trousers, high-rise waist, full length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy cotton twill.
Stiletto pumps, pointed toe, ankle height, burgundy wine (#800020), patent leather.
Pearl drop earrings, small round studs, medium length, white luster, cultured freshwater pearl.
A thin gold chain necklace, delicate link design, short length, antique gold, solid 14k gold.

This ensemble elevates her to a level of refined elegance suitable for an upscale autumn celebration, balancing structure with fluidity. The deep blue blazer and charcoal trousers provide a sophisticated foundation that feels seasonal without being heavy, while the silk blouse introduces necessary softness against the skin. Choosing burgundy shoes adds a touch of festive warmth that complements the fall palette, ensuring she stands out among the formal crowd. Every piece adheres to her request for formality while respecting her desire for an open neckline, creating a look that is both commanding and gracefully inviting."}
